meta.title: MotherFlame — Track
meta.description: Track your One Piece Card Game matches, analyze your performance, and master the meta.

hero.title: Track your matches.
hero.subtitle: MotherFlame is the free desktop app for One Piece TCG players. Log every game, analyze your stats, and crush your opponents with data.

showcase.title: See it in action
showcase.subtitle: Four tabs. Every detail of your game, right in front of you.
showcase.unlockCta: Unlock the Meta tab to access this

features.title: Everything you need to improve
features.subtitle: Four powerful tools in one app. Three are completely free.

items.title: Match Statistics
items.description: Spot where you struggle, whether going first or second or against specific leaders, and track your real progress game after game. Add personal notes after each match and review your sessions to know exactly what to work on.

items.title: Turn-by-Turn History
items.description: Review your starting hand to see if your opening was playable, then go through the full game with every card deployed and every attack logged. Your end-of-game notes are saved alongside so you can actually learn from each session.

items.title: Matchup Matrix
items.description: Get a full picture of your results against every leader in the meta. See your going-first and going-second win rates separately for each matchup, and quickly identify which ones to prioritize in your practice.

items.title: Meta Stats
items.description: Powered by over 1,000,000 matches and updated every day, the Meta tab tells you which decks rule the current meta and gives you the most-played decklists for each leader. Copy any list with one click and paste it straight into the simulator to test it yourself.

metaTeaser.label: META TAB — PREMIUM
metaTeaser.title: The competitive edge.
metaTeaser.subtitle: The Meta tab aggregates data from over 1,000,000 matches played on the simulator. Know which leaders are dominant, how to beat them, and what decklists the best players run.

download.title: Ready to level up?
download.subtitle: Download MotherFlame for free. No account needed, no ads, no nonsense.
